design system v1.7.1
updated 2026-10-19 · see CHANGELOG
bookkeepy · organisms 02
Workspace chrome, panels, editing and conversation.
The P1/P2/skip organisms, all composed from existing molecules. One new token family: rz-handle (resize handles on the interaction axis). Speech reuses interaction (selected = listening, loading = processing).
